Load a marker table

Source: R/scrna-markers.R
load_marker_table.Rd

Read a marker file and return either a canonical marker table or the raw object (a named list / matrix for RDS files, or the path string for xlsx files).

Usage

load_marker_table(path, cols = NULL)

Arguments

path

The path of the marker file. A file:// prefix is stripped, and a #col1,col2,... suffix selects columns (by name, alias or 1-based index).

cols

The columns to select. If NULL, they are taken from the # suffix of path when there is one.

Value

A canonical marker data.frame, or the raw object for native-format files.
